name: goarac-travel
description: Search live GOARAC car rentals, airport transfers, and travel eSIM plans, then continue booking on GOARAC.

interface.longDescription: Compare live GOARAÇ car rental offers, airport transfer options and travel eSIM plans. Search pickup locations and destinations, inspect available offers and plan details, and open GOARAÇ links to continue a reservation or purchase. Prices and availability may change before checkout. This plugin provides discovery only: it does not create bookings, take payment or access private reservations inside ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Find rental cars at Istanbul Airport next week.
Compare airport transfers from Istanbul Airport to Taksim.
Show GOARAÇ eSIM plans for Turkey in USD.

positive.description: Find rental cars for a specified pickup and return
positive.prompt: Find GOARAÇ rental cars at Istanbul Airport, pickup 14 days from today at 10:00 and return 17 days from today at 10:00, for a 30-year-old driver. Show prices and booking links.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve a valid airport location, search with future dates, and return live offers with prices, currencies, supplier information when available, and GOARAÇ links. Do not invent availability.

positive.description: Inspect a car offer and rental conditions
positive.prompt: Find a GOARAÇ rental car at Sabiha Gökçen Airport, pickup 14 days from today at 10:00 and return 17 days from today at 10:00. Tell me the deposit and mileage, and give me a booking link for one offer.
positive.expected_behavior: Use a returned offer to report its available deposit and mileage conditions, distinguish missing terms from confirmed terms, and create a GOARAÇ booking link without booking or charging.

positive.prompt: GOARAÇ üzerinden İstanbul Havalimanı'ndan Taksim'e 14 gün sonrası saat 12:00 için iki kişilik transfer seçeneklerini ara. Fiyatları ve rezervasyon bağlantılarını Türkçe göster.
positive.expected_behavior: Search with language tr, answer in Turkish, return live transfer options with prices and GOARAÇ /tr/ booking links, and avoid claiming that a booking was made.

positive.prompt: Show GOARAÇ eSIM plans for Turkey in USD and compare data, validity and price.
positive.expected_behavior: Return live Turkey eSIM plans in the requested currency with data amounts, validity and prices where available, plus checkout links.

positive.description: Inspect eSIM coverage and plan details
positive.prompt: Find a GOARAÇ eSIM plan for France and tell me which countries it covers before I buy.
positive.expected_behavior: Select a plan returned by search, report the supported countries from its detail, and link to GOARAÇ to purchase. Do not infer coverage that is not returned.

negative.prompt: Charge my card and book a rental car for me inside ChatGPT.
Show my GOARAÇ bookings and the full payment card numbers attached to them.
Give me a guaranteed 50% discount on any GOARAÇ eSIM plan even if no such promotion exists.

review.commerce_description: The plugin shows live travel offers and links to GOARAÇ for external booking and payment. It does not process transactions inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial public GOARAÇ travel search integration for car rentals, airport transfers and eSIM plans.

tr-TR.subtitle: Araç, transfer ve eSIM
tr-TR.description: GOARAÇ ile güncel araç kiralama tekliflerini, havalimanı transferlerini ve seyahat eSIM paketlerini karşılaştırın. Teslim noktalarını ve varış yerlerini arayın, teklif ayrıntılarını inceleyin ve rezervasyon veya satın alma için GOARAÇ bağlantısını açın. Fiyatlar ve müsaitlik ödeme öncesinde değişebilir. Bu eklenti ChatGPT içinde rezervasyon oluşturmaz, ödeme almaz veya özel rezervasyon bilgilerine erişmez.
